stratum.name: enron-qa-naturalistic
stratum.selected_question_sha256_method: sha256(utf8(json.dumps([{qid, question, evidence_ids}, ...], separators=(",",":")))) over the 20 selected rows in qid order -- deterministic, reproducible from the committed HF revision + seed 789 (782-hero convention, scoped to question+evidence identity, deliberately excluding the LLM-synthesized answer -- see synthesized_answer_sha256 below).
stratum.synthesized_answer_sha256_note: Recorded, NOT frozen as a binding identity: a local-model text generation is not guaranteed bit-reproducible across a different GPU/driver/llama.cpp build even at temperature 0. Scoring against these references is judge-authoritative by design (launch mandates a judge overlay), so an exact re-synthesis match is not required for validity -- only the QUESTION+EVIDENCE identity above is frozen.
stratum.gold_source: generated by scripts/jseval/789-corpora/enron-qa-answers/{select_subset,synthesize_answers}.py -- not committed (matches the no-external-content-committed convention; regenerate via recipe.json)

answers_resolution.reason: founder-ratified tempdoc 707 EN-email memo (2026-07-16) already found this exact annotation layer unlicensed and ratified dropping it project-wide in favor of real public-domain text + our own gold; see recipe.json.answers_resolution for the full citation chain
answers_resolution.resolution: local-model-synthesized reference answers (Qwen3.5-9B, temperature 0, thinking disabled), grounded in the FULL untruncated gold email text

closed_book_contamination_screen.note: NOT the sonnet closed-book calibration the real campaign runs (jseval corpus-certify). A 9B local model has far less memorization capacity than the launch model (sonnet) and most of these 20 questions are personal/logistics minutiae (meeting PINs, dinner plans) rather than the well-known Enron-scandal narrative facts a frontier model is likelier to have memorized -- so a 0/20 local-proxy result is a WEAK negative, not evidence the corpus is memorization-clean. The launch's own sonnet closed-book calibration step remains mandatory, not skippable on this result.
closed_book_contamination_screen.detail_path: produced by closed_book_screen.py; not committed (regenerate via recipe.json), full per-qid detail available in the tempdoc 789 dated section

launch_readiness.launch_arms: F1 (continuation), F2 (evidence-not-answer) only -- F0 control implicit as the no-flag baseline; F3 out of scope here (engine-side trigger redesign, tempdoc 789 'F3 trigger redesign' section, separately gated)
launch_readiness.cells_total_estimate: 2 arms x 20 qids x 2 seeds = 80 cells (F0 baseline optionally adds another 40 for a 3-arm comparison, matching the 782-hero P2 probe shape)
